importantNote: Added Previous and Next track switching buttons to the floating liquid glass music controller capsule.

changelog.category: Floating Music Controller Track Navigation Update (v1.6.5)
items: Enabled Previous (prevBtn) and Next (nextBtn) track switching controls directly inside the floating mini player capsule.
Arranged controls with touch-friendly spacing: Heart Favorite, Previous, Play/Pause, and Next.
Maintained 100% backend playback logic and event listeners.
Pushed release build v1.6.5 to GitHub and Vercel.
